platform: Windows 11; independent com0com peer and read-only live emulator
runtime_hash_scope: Sorted POSIX paths; path UTF-8 + NUL + UTF-8 content with LF. crates/**/*.{rs,toml,js,css,html}, Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, plugins/calibration.example.json, plugins/*/plugin.json.

checks: managed package acquisition with owned COM; control status and native port enumeration
browser wiring/disable/re-enable/fanout and settings apply without process restart
scan skips broadcast zero; interleaved acquisition; no second COM owner
full 1..100 scan remains within status bound while acquisition advances
per-address errors persist after recovery; reset preserves availability
busy destination COM rolls back to working configuration with same source process
external configuration edit is never overwritten by stale UI
validated configuration change and preserved before/after history
management requires presentation key; only FC03 observed

tests: pointer drag creates staged binding; Apply persists
middle-click disables without deleting calibration; snapshot clears value
one output fans out to several parameters
port timing settings hot-apply without process restart
module reorder preserves physical channel IDs
scan starts and cancels through source owner
raw -> historical map -> independently verified 0/0.5/1; duplicate input
backlog uses historical revision; activation boundary; stale map/tampered result rejected
uPlot bridge history; no key/cross-origin rejection; screen stop leaves ingestion
independent CSV/backup CRC readers; consumer restart without duplicate rows
forced core termination preserves confirmed prefix; recovered values are not fresh
restore into empty profile solely from backup; exact independent event comparison
switching tabs during return to live clears history anchor
multiple intermediate scroll positions; settled target; bounded plot requests
parameter selection and separate calibration window
calibration zoom in/out changes both axes reversibly
calibration background pan preserves points, draft and core map
grid strokes and equal-valued ticks follow both pan axes
fit and signal-unit changes reset viewport
voltage/raw view roundtrip without changing points
external map revision preserves open editor; cancel reloads it

independent_checks: voltage points persisted as exact raw codes
interpreter result checked against independent formula
continuous synthetic ingestion; no COM access

limits: One managed IM2480 instance per profile; one owned COM port.
FC03/order 0009=0 and six channels per module only; no device-register writes or alternate DOL modes.
Line configuration and calibration-map save are separate acknowledged operations.
Line history is local and not yet included in the generic core settings journal/JSONL backup.
Modules UI is a built-in host contribution gated by package presence, not a general web plugin SDK.
No physical hardware, Windows 10, macOS, weak-machine, GPU, power-loss or 24-72h acceptance.
